columns.name: gid
columns.description: Globally unique identifier of the AuditLogEvent.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: The type of the event.

columns.name: event_category
columns.description: The category that this event_type belongs to.

columns.name: actor
columns.description: The entity that triggered the event. Will typically be a user.

columns.name: resource
columns.description: The primary object that was affected by this event.

columns.name: details
columns.description: Event specific details.

columns.name: context
columns.description: The context from which this event originated.

columns.name: ActorType
columns.description: The type of actor. Can be one of user, asana, asana_support, anonymous, or external_administrator.

columns.name: ActorEmail
columns.description: The email of the actor, if it is a user.

columns.name: ActorGid
columns.description: Globally unique identifier of the actor, if it is a user.

columns.name: ActorName
columns.description: The name of the actor, if it is a user.

columns.name: ApiAuthenticationMethod
columns.description: The authentication method used in the context of an API request. Only present if the context_type is api. Can be one of cookie, oauth, personal_access_token, or service_account.

columns.name: SrcIpAddr
columns.description: The IP address of the client that initiated the event, if applicable.

columns.name: ContextType
columns.description: The type of context. Can be one of web, desktop, mobile, asana_support, asana, email, or api.

columns.name: UserAgent
columns.description: The user agent of the client that initiated the event, if applicable.

columns.name: OauthAppName
columns.description: The name of the OAuth App that initiated the event. Only present if the api_authentication_method is oauth.

columns.name: RuleName
columns.description: The name of the automation rule that initiated the event.

columns.name: ResourceEmail
columns.description: The email of the resource, if applicable.

columns.name: ResourceGid
columns.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource.

columns.name: ResourceName
columns.description: The name of the resource.

columns.name: ResourceSubType
columns.description: The subtype of resource. Most resources will not have a subtype.

columns.name: ResourceType
columns.description: The type of resource.
